spy.summary: A young spy in a dark green hood and cape, with a raised gold spyglass and a folded note. The model matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The green hood, the long cape, the brown leather vest with straps, and the brown boots match the mockup.
The raised spyglass arm and the note in the other hand match the mockup pose.
The face reads as playful and cheeky, and it reads in the 128 px sprites.
issues: The spyglass is short and wide at the top, so it reads as a bell or a seal stamp. Make it longer, with two or three tube segments.
The hair is dark brown. The mockup hair is near black. Make the hair darker.
The hood has a small knob on the top. The mockup hood is smooth. Remove the knob.
The vest has fewer pouches than the mockup, and the belt pouches are small.
The walk is stiff, and the raised arm stays still (a known base limit).
spy.next: Make the spyglass a longer brass tube with segments, so that it reads as a spyglass at 128 px.

regent.summary: An old regent in a plum robe with gold trim, round gold glasses, a gold chain with a key, a gold seal, and a scroll. The model matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The plum robe with gold trim at the hem and the cuffs, and the gold chain with the key, match the mockup.
The round gold glasses and the kind face read well in front, side, and sprites.
The gold seal and the scroll are in the correct hands and touch the fists.
issues: The hair is a tall pointed swirl of curls in near white. The mockup hair is a gray, combed-back bun. Make the bun lower and the hair gray.
The ears are small. The mockup ears are large. Make the ears larger.
The high collar is weak. Add a clear raised collar or cowl at the neck.
The scroll is at an angle. The mockup scroll is upright.
The walk is stiff, and the posed arm stays still (a known base limit).
regent.next: Change the hair to a lower, gray, combed-back bun.

royal-guard.summary: A royal guard in a red and gold uniform, a silver helmet with a red plume, a mustache, and an upright halberd. It is the same character as the mockup, with clear differences in the legs and the helmet.
strengths: The silver helmet with the red plume and the gold emblem reads in every view and in the sprites.
The halberd is upright, the axe blade points out, and the shaft touches the fist.
The mustache and the red coat with gold buttons and a black belt match the mockup.
issues: The white trousers are missing. The red coat continues to the black boots. Add white trousers between the coat and the boots.
The cheek guards are large round discs and read as ear muffs. Make them narrow flaps along the cheeks.
The gold epaulettes are not in the mockup. Make them smaller or red.
The halberd shaft is light brown. The mockup shaft is dark.
The walk is stiff, and the posed arm stays still (a known base limit).
royal-guard.next: Add white trousers and make the red coat shorter, so that the mockup red, white, and black value plan reads.

soldier.summary: A young soldier in a blue tabard with a castle emblem over chain mail, with a silver helmet, an upright spear, and a round shield. It is the same character as the mockup, with clear differences in the shield and the helmet.
strengths: The blue tabard with the white castle emblem, the chain mail sleeves, and the brown belt match the mockup.
The spear is upright and touches the fist, and the shield is on the other arm.
The braid at the back and the young face read in the sprites.
issues: The shield has a blue and white target pattern. The mockup shield is light blue with a silver rim and a gold star boss. Change the shield paint.
The helmet surface has a rough ripple texture. The mockup helmet is smooth plate. Remove the ripple from the helmet.
The smile is weak. The mockup face is more cheerful. Make the smile wider.
The mockup has tall leather leg wraps. The model has short boots.
The walk is stiff, and the posed arm stays still (a known base limit).
soldier.next: Paint the shield light blue with a silver rim and a gold star boss, as in the mockup.

veteran.summary: A bald old veteran with a gray mustache, a blue coat, a cane, and an old helmet at his hip. It is the same character as the mockup, but the model looks clean and new where the mockup looks grizzled and worn.
strengths: The bald head, the gray side hair, the large gray mustache, and the big nose read in every view and in the sprites.
The cane touches the fist and reaches the ground. The helmet brim touches the other fist.
The helmet has vent slots and a spike, as in the mockup.
issues: The helmet is bright silver. The mockup helmet is dark, old bronze. Make the helmet dark and dull.
The coat is a clean, bright blue. The mockup coat is a worn teal blue. Add wear, darker seams, and a duller color.
The dark trousers are missing. The coat continues to the boots. Show dark trousers above the boots.
The gold epaulettes and the red medal are not in the mockup. They are small additions.
The walk is stiff, and the posed arm stays still (a known base limit).
veteran.next: Make the helmet dark bronze and the coat a worn, duller teal blue, so that the model reads as an old veteran.
